name: Checkpoint (Wi-Fi sign-in page with a code and a find log)
description: An open Wi-Fi network whose sign-in page is the checkpoint: a title, a few lines of text, a code, and a callsign box. Phones that join pop the page by themselves (captive DNS). Each callsign handed in goes into finds.csv on the fox; Collect finds on the Bench tab gathers them into the fleet log. The page content is the checkpoint section on the Payload tab.
